title: Podcasts Overtook Radio By Just 1 Percentage Point
hook: Radio lost its spoken-word lead to podcasts by just 1 percentage point.
closing: A tiny lead marks a change in where people spend listening time, rather than radio disappearing.
question: What do you choose for spoken audio?

segments.say: Podcasts reached 40% of spoken-word listening in the supplied comparison. Their share quadrupled over the measured decade.
Podcasts led radio by 1 percentage point in the measured quarter. A narrow margin still reversed their positions.
Weekly podcast listening reached 35% of Americans in these data. Regular use extends beyond occasional curiosity.
